verdict_reason: PARKED — untestable on public data. The extraction pipeline works (836 filings, 0 errors), but coverage inverts the thesis: public filings exist only for the ~50 largest banks, precisely where structured data is richest and events are rarest (base rate 1.27% vs 5.62% panel-wide). Incremental AUC +0.0022 on 472 rows / 6 events is unmeasurable, not null. Extraction precision for this flag is 0.46 against 30 blind hand labels. Testing whether text adds value where structured data is blind requires proprietary transcripts covering the uninstrumented part of the book.
